reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io` changes v2beta1 → v2", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing CleanupPolicy objects remain stored as v2beta1 until rewritten; a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update are needed before a later release removes v2beta1.
consequence.remediation: Re-write all CleanupPolicy objects and update status.storedVersions of the CRD before a later release removes v2beta1.

proposed.statement: The storage version of the cleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD changes from v2beta1 to v2 (1.12.6 → 1.13.0), so existing CleanupPolicy objects stay stored as v2beta1 until a storage version migration is run.
